panels.description: NEXUS — TWO ACCESS POINTS, LATER. A coastal Antarctic cave laboratory with two visibly separate access routes and separate arrival vehicles. Falcon is not visible. Leave upper-left clear.
Inside the shared Nexus corridor. Sitara, Roman, and Nayah meet beneath warped metal and blue ice; their two separate TJs face one another across a frozen threshold. Leave top third clear.
Roman holds Orien's chemical calibration sheet while Sitara holds the Falcon fragment. Their eyes stay on the documents. Leave upper third clear.
Nayah plants a route marker at the corridor entrance. A clear arrow points back toward the exit. Leave upper-left clear.

items.speaker: ROMAN
items.text: This code is in your record.

items.speaker: SITARA
items.text: Your record is the second half.

items.speaker: NAYAH
items.text: We work inside the route. We leave when I say.
